span.p: rollback·key intent 또는 latest revision 재조회

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NOT_REQUESTED → REQUEST_SENT
REQUEST_SENT → REPLY_ACKNOWLEDGED 또는 REPLY_DELETION_CONFIRMED 또는 REPLY_DECLINED
REPLY_ACKNOWLEDGED → REPLY_DELETION_CONFIRMED 또는 REPLY_DECLINED
REPLY_DECLINED → REQUEST_SENT
REPLY_DELETION_CONFIRMED은 종료

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
실제 기관 통신·사본삭제를 수행하지 않음
자동 retry·취소 API 없음·회신 증거는 수기 기록
